content: When responding to UDS Service 0x19 with subfunction 0x06, 0x10 or 0x19, the Dcm module shall calculate the DTCExtendedDataRecord by first calling Dem_SelectExtendedDataRecord() with the parameter values set according to Table 7.16 and then call Dem_GetNextExtendedDataRecord() repeatedly until DEM_NO_SUCH_ELEMENT is returned.

When responding to UDS Service 0x19 with subfunction 0x06, 0x10 or 0x19, the Dcm module shall calculate the DTCExtendedDataRecord by first calling Dem_SelectExtendedDataRecord() with the parameter values set according to Table 7.14 and then call Dem_GetNextExtendedDataRecord() repeatedly until DEM_NO_SUCH_ELEMENT is returned.

When responding to UDS Service 0x19 with subfunction 0x06 or 0x19, the Dcm module shall calculate the DTCExtendedDataRecord by first calling Dem_SelectExtendedDataRecord() with the parameter values set according to Table 7.14 and then call Dem_GetNextExtendedDataRecord() repeatedly until DEM_NO_SUCH_ELEMENT is returned.

When responding to UDS Service 0x19 with subfunction 0x06 or 0x19, the Dcm module shall calculate the DTCExtendedDataRecord by first calling Dem_SelectExtendedDataRecord() with the parameter values set according to Table 7.12 and then call Dem_GetNextExtendedDataRecord() repeatedly until DEM_NO_SUCH_ELEMENT is returned.
